findings.finding: Fact corrections changed misinformation beliefs without corresponding reliable politician feeling/voting-intention shifts in this study. This is not evidence that every lie has zero electoral cost or that a US reporter revelation has the same treatment.

findings.finding: Recorded roll calls are selected from legislative voting and can differ from voice/unrecorded decisions. Recorded votes alone are not a representative set of every decision; study does not supply an individual constituent support coefficient.
